subject: math
description: Define and use basic polygon vocabulary, including side, vertex, diagonal, regular polygon, and irregular polygon.
learningObjectives: Define polygon, side, vertex, diagonal, regular polygon, and irregular polygon
Identify examples and non-examples of polygons
Label sides, vertices, and diagonals in a polygon
Classify simple polygons as regular or irregular using side and angle information
prerequisites: Counting sides and corners of plane figures
Using a ruler to compare side lengths
